prompts.name: mission-blueprint
prompts.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: finished landscape one-page game design document, high-resolution raster image, approximately 3:2 aspect ratio.
Primary request: Create ONE complete polished one-pager for the game HEIRS OF SOL. Use the attached hand-drawn sketch as structural inspiration, not as a photograph to reproduce. Preserve its left-hand gameplay pillars, central colony map, right-hand three-phase goal, and bottom player-choice idea. Flat page, straight-on, edge-to-edge artwork, no desk or device.
Readability is essential: large clear typography, deliberate whitespace, short readable paragraphs, strong hierarchy. All copy below must be spelled correctly and fit with generous margins. Do not add other game mechanics, combat, currencies, invented scores, rules, time limits, or claims.
Content and exact copy:
Main title: "HEIRS OF SOL"
Subtitle: "16 colonies. One shared goal: reclaim Earth."
Abstract, under title: "The Sun mysteriously dimmed, freezing Earth. Humanity fled in hundreds of small expeditions. Only 16 found habitable worlds. Lead one of these colonies and help humanity return home."
LEFT COLUMN section title: "DEVELOP YOUR COLONY"
Four illustrated rows:
"EXTRACT RESOURCES" / "Gather the materials for colonies, fleets and megastructures."
"ADVANCE SCIENCE" / "Research megastructures, solar restoration and terraforming."
"BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE" / "Develop mines, laboratories, shipyards and construction sites."
"MANAGE LOGISTICS" / "Move resources between worlds and building sites."
CENTER: spacious stylized galaxy/star map with exactly 16 small colony markers and varied habitable worlds, freight-route connections, and a small separate dim Sun/frozen Earth callout. Label one colony "YOUR COLONY". Label the dim star "DIMMED SOL". Label its nearby icy world "FROZEN EARTH". Map represents the galaxy, not 16 planets all orbiting Sol. The player colonies connect through logistics and cooperation.
RIGHT COLUMN section title: "RECLAIM EARTH"
Three distinct clearly numbered milestones connected top-to-bottom by directional arrows:
"01 — BUILD A DYSON SWARM" / "Surround a star with energy collectors to power solar restoration."
"02 — RESTORE THE SUN" / "Understand and reverse the dimming. Return Sol to its original light."
"03 — RECLAIM EARTH" / "Thaw the planet, rebuild its infrastructure and repopulate it."
Use illustrations of star surrounded by many discrete collectors, Sun being restored, and Earth with ice receding and returning greenery. The Dyson swarm's star can be another star: do not imply it must be Sol. Left pillars operate across all three phases, not a fixed linear sequence of four tasks.
BOTTOM full-width band title: "COOPERATE OR WIN ALONE"
Footer copy: "Specialize and combine strengths, or develop every capability yourself. Players are scored on their contributions across the three phases. Contribute to one phase, several, or the entire mission."
Overall communicate hopeful human recovery, industrial development, scientific progress, interstellar logistics, shared objective and individual contribution. No military imagery. No watermark.
Visual theme: MISSION BLUEPRINT. Deep midnight navy paper with subtle technical grid, fine cyan and ivory drafting lines, restrained amber highlights for the three milestones. Crisp engineering diagrams, schematic colonies, clean orbital arcs and collector modules. Contemporary aerospace mission-planning aesthetic. Title in bold clean sans serif, text in highly legible sans serif, no illegibly tiny technical filler. Center galaxy chart largest illustration; right milestone panels clear and separated. Quiet precise elegance.
